migrationObservation.scope: SELECT metadata hashes only; no statement text, Auth records, business rows or writes
migrationObservation.query:
select version, name, coalesce(array_length(statements,1),0) as statement_count, statements is null as statements_missing, md5(replace(array_to_string(statements,E'
'),E'
',E'
')) as lf_joined_md5, md5(btrim(replace(array_to_string(statements,E'
'),E'
',E'
'),E' 	
')) as lf_boundary_trimmed_md5 from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations order by version

publicSchemaObservation.scope: Public catalog metadata only; no business rows, Auth records, SQL function bodies or writes returned
publicSchemaObservation.query:
select jsonb_build_object(
'tables', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'table', c.relname, 'kind', c.relkind, 'rls', c.relrowsecurity, 'force_rls', c.relforcerowsecurity,
  'options', c.reloptions,
  'columns', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',a.attname,'type',pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'not_null',a.attnotnull,'default_md5',md5(pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid))) order by a.attnum),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_attribute a left join pg_catalog.pg_attrdef d on d.adrelid=a.attrelid and d.adnum=a.attnum where a.attrelid=c.oid and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped),
  'anon',jsonb_build_object('select',has_table_privilege('anon',c.oid,'SELECT'),'insert',has_table_privilege('anon',c.oid,'INSERT'),'update',has_table_privilege('anon',c.oid,'UPDATE'),'delete',has_table_privilege('anon',c.oid,'DELETE')),
  'authenticated',jsonb_build_object('select',has_table_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'SELECT'),'insert',has_table_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'INSERT'),'update',has_table_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'UPDATE'),'delete',has_table_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'DELETE'))
) order by c.relname),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_class c join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and c.relkind in ('r','p','v','m')),
'policies', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',c.relname,'name',p.polname,'command',p.polcmd,'permissive',p.polpermissive,'roles',(select jsonb_agg(case when r=0 then 'PUBLIC' else pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(r)::text end order by r) from unnest(p.polroles) r),'using_md5',md5(pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(p.polqual,p.polrelid)),'check_md5',md5(pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck,p.polrelid))) order by c.relname,p.polname),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_policy p join pg_catalog.pg_class c on c.oid=p.polrelid join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public'),
'functions',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',p.proname,'arguments',pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),'result',pg_catalog.pg_get_function_result(p.oid),'security_definer',p.prosecdef,'volatility',p.provolatile,'definition_md5',md5(pg_catalog.pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)),'anon_execute',has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'authenticated_execute',has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE')) order by p.proname,pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid)),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_proc p join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.prokind in ('f','p')),
'constraints',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',c.relname,'name',co.conname,'type',co.contype,'definition_md5',md5(pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(co.oid,true))) order by c.relname,co.conname),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_constraint co join pg_catalog.pg_class c on c.oid=co.conrelid join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public')
) as metadata
